baseline.meaning: Term-end-only baseline misses earlier automatic-renewal notice dates.

limitations: Calendar-day planning worksheet, not legal advice. Dates and notice lengths are supplied and human-verified; AI does not extract numbers or determine enforceability. No business-day, delivery, jurisdiction, holiday or recurring-renewal calculation. Fixed/opt-in term end is a planning placeholder, not a legally determined deadline. Past dates are preserved, never rolled forward.
